##### Project general facts

Pearl House II by Imtiaz is a truly captivating residence that celebrates the timeless elegance of pearls in every graceful line and refined detail. Taking the organic shape of a pearl, the building wears a beautifully sinuous, sculpted facade that turns heads and makes coming home feel like an occasion. The collection features elegant designer studios and designer one-bedroom apartments, each framed by stunning panoramic views and offering a wonderful blend of cosmopolitan style, sophistication and everyday comfort.

Residents are spoiled with a rich set of amenities created for relaxation, wellness and easy socialising. A spectacular rooftop infinity pool and a luxury rooftop gym fitted with the latest equipment sit alongside a welcoming clubhouse and an elegant club room with a billiard table for effortless evenings with neighbours and friends. A state-of-the-art kids play area, a tranquil landscaped courtyard, a built-in home office space, electric vehicle recharging stations and extra visitor parking round out an offering that genuinely covers every need.

The interiors are shaped by an award-winning designer and curated to deliver an elegant, sophisticated space with the perfect touch of luxury and opulence. Each apartment arrives fully furnished with custom-made furniture and equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, beautiful Italian tiles, premium sanitaryware and fixtures, a 65-inch television and a 24-inch iMac, while nature-inspired colour schemes create a tranquil and calming mood throughout. Clean lines, clever storage solutions and curated artwork complete the picture, and smart home technology adds keyless entry, voice-controlled automation and remote climate control for a wonderfully seamless lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits 

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
